dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped ring structures are visible along the dorsal ridge and mid-lateral flank. These exhibit sharp gradients from a dark-grey exterior to high-intensity white/light-grey perimeters, often enclosing a textured dark-grey core. The perimeter edges are irregular and non-uniform in thickness, particularly on the three most prominent rings located on the upper-mid torso.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High concentration of small, solid high-intensity pixel clusters is observed along the uppermost dorsal midline, creating a stippled effect. These clusters lack internal gradients and are most dense near the top-center curve of the body, thinning out towards the lower lateral sections.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest macro-annuli on the upper flank form an elongated, irregular quadrilateral. The geometric relationship follows the convex curvature of the dorsal line, with the internal angles between centroids being obtuse (approximately 145-160 degrees).

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region displays a unique micro-stippling texture where high-intensity pixels are distributed in a much higher density and smaller scale compared to the macro-annuli of the main body, creating a frosted visual appearance.
